title: FDA approves Sunharbo (asundexian) to reduce the risk of stroke in adults following a recent mild-to-moderate non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke or a high-risk transient ischemic attack
summary: Novel drug approval of 11/9/2026: Sunharbo (asundexian) to reduce the risk of stroke in adults following a recent mild-to-moderate non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke or a high-risk transient ischemic attack.
